query: SELECT pl_name, hostname, discoverymethod, disc_year, ra, dec, sy_vmag, sy_pnum, pl_orbper, pl_orbpererr1, pl_orbpererr2, pl_rade, pl_radeerr1, pl_radeerr2, pl_bmassj, pl_bmassjerr1, pl_bmassjerr2, pl_bmassprov, pl_eqt, pl_eqterr1, pl_eqterr2, sy_dist, sy_disterr1, sy_disterr2 FROM pscomppars WHERE sy_dist IS NOT NULL
fields: planets[]: pl_name, discoverymethod, disc_year, pl_orbper [d], pl_rade [R_earth], pl_bmassj [M_jup], pl_eqt [K, value only]; other numbers are value, [value, err] (symmetric) or [value, err1, err2] as in the archive (err1 >= 0, err2 <= 0); pl_bmassprov = 'Msini' marks minimum masses; masses from the archive's mass-radius relation are omitted.

citations.ref: NASA Exoplanet Archive, Planetary Systems Composite Data (pscomppars)
Akeson et al. 2013, PASP 125, 989 (NASA Exoplanet Archive)
